item.description: Governor Monday Okpebholo has invited Arise News anchors Rufai Oseni and Reuben Abati to Edo State to see ongoing development projects after they criticized his administration.

item.title: Showmax To Shut Down After 11 Years As MultiChoice Moves To Restructure Streaming Business
item.description: Showmax announces plans to discontinue its streaming service after 11 years, despite major investments and a recent Canal+ takeover.

item.title: Nigeria’s External Reserves Climb To $50.45 Billion, Highest Level In 13 Years
item.description: Nigeria’s external reserves rise to $50.45 billion, highest in 13 years, strengthening buffers for imports, debt servicing and currency stability.

item.title: Tinubu Appoints Ibrahim Masari Special Adviser On Political Affairs

item.title: Nigeria Needs $23bn To Electrify 143,000 Underserved Communities, REA Reveals
item.description: Nigeria needs $23bn to expand electricity access to 143,000 communities as power shortage continues to hinder economic growth, says REA.
